missionStatement:
You have learned what ethical hacking is, how attackers think, and what the law permits. Now it is time to understand the process that turns those skills into a professional engagement.

In the field, ethical hacking is not freestyle — it follows a structured methodology. Every professional penetration test moves through five phases: Scoping, Reconnaissance, Scanning and Enumeration, Exploitation, and Reporting. Each phase has defined inputs, defined activities, and a defined output that feeds the next phase.

Your mission: understand each phase well enough to explain it to a client, and understand the documents — scope agreement, Rules of Engagement, final report — that govern and record the entire engagement.
objectives: Map the five VAPT phases in order and identify each phase's primary output
Explain what a scope document contains and why its precision is legally critical
Describe what Rules of Engagement govern and why they protect both parties
Understand why the report is the deliverable — not the exploitation
Learn the Penetration Testing Execution Standard (PTES) seven-phase framework
operativeNote: Organisations pay for reports, not exploits. A security engagement that produces thorough documentation is worth more than one that compromises every system but leaves no paper trail. Remember that as you move through this mission.
